sections_breakdown.title: Hero Section
sections_breakdown.subtext: Um mini universo cheio de detalhes, fofuras e curiosidades que reuni só pensando em você.
sections_breakdown.interactions_and_animations: On-load masked line-by-line reveal animation using Framer Motion. Smooth scroll trigger when clicking CTA button. Background features floating SVG bows & hearts with parallax starry sky background.

sections_breakdown.title: Multiverso Rick and Morty Section
sections_breakdown.portal_quote: Com infinitas dimensões e linhas do tempo no multiverso, dar a sorte de te conhecer nessa dimensão específica é estatisticamente inacreditável... e incrível.
sections_breakdown.interactions_and_animations: Portal green accent (#10B981) glowing ring effect against starry cosmic sky. Clicking CTA button plays swirling portal animation sound & vortex visual overlay that changes the dimensional quote.

sections_breakdown.title: Hello Kitty Corner 🎀
sections_breakdown.subtext: Clique nas lacinhos e cartas para revelar mensagens escondidas guardadas com todo carinho.
sections_breakdown.interactions_and_animations: Cute soft pink grid with Hello Kitty decorative elements. Interactive flip cards & clickable bows that burst hearts and reveal secret cute compliments.

sections_breakdown.title: Laboratório Secreto do Dexter 🔎
sections_breakdown.revelation_text: Investigação inconclusiva. A principal suspeita é esse seu jeitinho.
sections_breakdown.interactions_and_animations: Dark green tech laboratory aesthetic with radar scanner motion. Clicking 'Analisar Evidências' runs a typing scanner code and reveals the playful conclusion message with pop-up badge.

sections_breakdown.title: Cat Corner Mini-Game 🐱
sections_breakdown.game_instructions: Passe o cursor ou toque nos gatinhos para fazer carinho! A cada carinho você ganha um elogio e preenche o Fofurômetro.
sections_breakdown.interactive_elements: 3 interactive cat avatars (Gatinho Pudim, Miau Estelar, Frufru). Petting cats plays sound meow, triggers floating heart particles, adds +1 to collect progress bar, and displays sweet personalized compliments.
sections_breakdown.completion_reward: Reaching 100% unlocks a special 'Master do Carinho' digital badge!

sections_breakdown.title: Bento Grid: Descobrindo Você ✨
sections_breakdown.heading_text: Coisas que estou descobrindo sobre você
phrases: Seu sorriso ilumina qualquer dia cinzento sem nem fazer esforço.
A forma como você fala das coisas que ama é contagiante.
Você tem um gosto impecável para pequenos detalhes do dia a dia.
Sua energia traz uma paz tão gostosa que dá vontade de ficar conversando por horas.
E o mais importante: você é completamente única neste multiverso.
sections_breakdown.layout: Asymmetric Bento Grid with 5 custom styled cards featuring subtle hover tilt, neon pink borders, and floating icon decorations.

sections_breakdown.title: Carta Feita à Mão 💌
sections_breakdown.content: Ainda estamos no começo dessa história de nos conhecermos, mas cada conversinha com você tem um brilho diferente. Não precisei de nenhum laboratório ou cálculo espacial para perceber o quanto você é especial. Espero que essa coisinha traga um sorrisinho pro seu rosto hoje!
sections_breakdown.styling: Warm tactile parchment paper card with cursive handwritten font ('Caveat'), floating heart wax seal button, and ambient candle light glow.

sections_breakdown.title: Grand Finale & Surpresa 🎆
reply_options: Amei, quando é o nosso encontro? ☕✨
sections_breakdown.celebration_animation: Triggers massive confetti explosion, floating Hello Kitty, cat emojis, glowing stars, floating hearts, sound effect, and displays funny warm interactive confirmation response.

data_testid_convention.rule: Every interactive button, link, toggle, input, and response state MUST have a unique data-testid in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts ('Fredoka', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Caveat', 'Space Mono') into public/index.html or index.css.
Build the page using React 19 + Framer Motion in standard JS (.js / .jsx) files.
Maintain the exact Brazilian Portuguese strings requested in the problem statement for all 8 sections.
Include a sticky navigation header with logo bow SVG 'Mundinho', section jump links, and a cute sound/mute toggle button.
Ensure sound effects use Web Audio API oscillators so no external audio MP3 asset downloads fail.
Add responsive mobile-first 390px support with full width touch targets and smooth single-scroll experience.
All interactive cards, buttons, and progress counters MUST use data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, avoid AI slop: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without harsh gradients. Do not use dark colors as muddy full screen gradients.
Do not center align everything by default. Use asymmetrical grids, diagonals, and negative space to guide flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, active presses, smooth Framer Motion transitions, and entrance animations.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
Use sonner for toasts when user completes actions (e.g. cat petting progress reached, secret notes revealed).
